bagPolicy.summary: Thunder Ridge Nature Arena enforces a clear bag policy. Small purses and handbags are allowed but will undergo a security check.
allowed: Clear Bag/Totes - no larger than 12 x 6 x 12
Small Clutch Purse - no bigger than 4.5 x 6.5
bagPolicy.note: Medical and Diaper bags are allowed and must be checked in upon entry.

parking.note: General admission parking is free with a valid concert ticket, while Diamond and Premium parking are available for purchase. ADA parking is also free with a valid ticket. Tailgating is allowed with restrictions, and RV parking is available without hookups.

rideshare.note: Follow signs for Rideshare & Guest Pick up/Drop off. Tram service runs before and after events between the designated area and the venue.

concessions.note: The Thunder Ridge Nature Arena offers a full-service bar in the exclusive arena lounge, providing a cool-off area with A/C, private restrooms, lounge seating, and an outdoor patio. The venue operates as a cashless facility, accepting only debit and credit card transactions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is limited and reserved for guests with accessibility needs and their companions. You can buy one accessible seat plus one adjacent companion seat, and additional guests are seated as close as possible, depending on availability.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed once your ticket has been scanned.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call tickets will be available at the Thunder Ridge Nature Arena Box Office one hour before doors open for each event. The Box Office opens when the fan zone and parking lots open.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Fast Lane Pass holders use the dedicated Fast Lane entry at the front of the venue and show both their event ticket and Fast Lane voucher. Each guest needs their own voucher, and a Fast Lane Pass is not an admission ticket.
